description: The digits 403 stand side by side on a common baseline. An open angular four precedes a tall oval zero and a three formed by two rounded lobes.
A small circular centre joins a sweeping outer loop that curls around it. The outer stroke opens at the lower right, while a short inner return connects beside the central bowl.
A capital A and an open-topped numeral four sit side by side. The A has a horizontal crossbar, and the four combines a diagonal arm with a long upright stem.
The capital letters API form a horizontal wordmark on a shared baseline. The A has a crossbar, the P has a rounded upper bowl, and the I has horizontal end bars.
The label 2M sits above a horizontal double-headed arrow. The numeral has a curved top and flat foot, while the tall capital M has sharply alternating diagonal strokes.
The label 2M sits above a horizontal double-headed arrow. The numeral has a curved top and flat foot, while the tall capital M has sharply alternating diagonal strokes.
The label 2m sits above a horizontal double-headed arrow. A curved numeral two stands beside a lowercase m with two rounded arches, spanning the width of the arrow below.
A straight horizontal arrow points right toward a small hollow circular target. Its open arrowhead stops just before the circle, with both elements aligned along the same horizontal centre.
Two curved arrows chase one another around an open circular path. Their arrowheads occupy the upper-right and lower-left corners, leaving small breaks between the two opposing curved strokes.
Two upright aerial bombs hang at different heights, with the left bomb higher than the right. Each rounded body meets a small angular tail fin with a deep V-shaped notch.
Two upright aerial bombs hang at different heights, with the left bomb higher than the right. Each rounded body meets a small angular tail fin with a deep V-shaped notch.
A small bottle tilts downward toward the lower left, with its open neck nearest a falling teardrop. A curved liquid boundary crosses the bottle body behind the narrow mouth.
A small bottle tilts downward toward the lower left, with its open neck nearest a falling teardrop. A curved liquid boundary crosses the bottle body behind the narrow mouth.
A large circular bubble touches a much smaller bubble at its upper-right edge. Both circles have empty centres and smooth contours, forming a compact diagonal pair with clearly different sizes.
A capital C with a broad rounded bowl stands to the left of two small plus signs. The plus signs share a horizontal centre and sit close together beside the open letter.
A diagonal slash rises from the lower left to the upper right across a circular ring. The slash meets the ring at both ends, dividing its open centre into two segments.
A wide rounded speech bubble has a pointed tail projecting downward near its right edge. Two horizontal text strokes occupy the upper half, with the upper line longer than the lower one.
A rounded square speech bubble has a long pointed tail at the lower right. Two short upright eyes and a downturned curved mouth give the bubble a simple sad face.
A rounded square speech bubble has a long pointed tail at the lower right. Two short upright eyes and a downturned curved mouth give the bubble a simple sad face.
An outlined cube shows its top and two side faces above a right-angled dimension line. The line runs beneath the cube and up its right side, ending in leftward and upward arrowheads.
A tall rectangular building rises from a shared ground line beside a shorter annex with a sloping roof. Two short horizontal window marks run down the front of the taller block.
A broad C-shaped curve opens to the right and is crossed by one horizontal bar. The bar projects beyond the curve on the left and ends inside its open centre.
A circular face contains sharply slanted eyebrows above two small eyes. A downturned mouth sits beneath them, with the brows leaning inward to form a tense, nearly symmetrical expression.
A round head sits above broad curved shoulders and short squared-off sleeves. Two vertical torso sides continue below the sleeve corners, leaving the bottom of the simplified standing figure open.
Two open hands face inward with raised outer fingers and gently cupped palms. Short inner finger lines follow the palms, while the wrists descend separately, leaving an open space between the hands.

A hand rises from below a floating cube with its index finger extended toward the cube’s open lower-left edge. The cube shows its top and right faces, and the remaining fingers fold beside the pointing finger.
An Om-like symbol combines two rounded left lobes with a sweeping lower-right curve. A small upper-right curved stroke and a detached dot sit above the central connection of the larger curves.
A key lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a large circular bow at its upper end. A straight shaft extends downward and carries two short teeth near its tip.
A broad leaf points to the right, its curved upper and lower edges meeting at a narrow tip. A short stem enters from the lower left and continues inside as a curved central vein.
A teardrop-shaped leaf points toward the upper left with a broad rounded lower-right side. A curved central vein continues beyond that side as a short stem descending toward the lower right.
A symmetrical heart has two rounded upper lobes and a pointed lower tip. Two horizontal dividers span its lower half, creating broad stacked bands that narrow toward the point.
A tall angular lightning bolt slopes from upper right to lower left. Its pointed ends connect through a pair of offset horizontal notches, enclosing a narrow zigzag-shaped interior.
The capital letters LIVE sit in one horizontal row. The I has short horizontal caps, the V has a pointed lower junction, and the E has three projecting horizontal arms.
A rounded speech bubble has a pointed tail extending down and left. Two short vertical eyes sit above a broad upward-curving smile, turning the whole bubble into a friendly face.
A rounded square speech bubble has a long pointed tail at the lower right. Two short upright eyes and a downturned curved mouth give the bubble a simple sad face.
A long diagonal arrow points down and right toward a small horizontal rectangle. Its open right-angled head stops above the rectangle’s upper-left corner, leaving a clear gap between them.
A bell has a small rounded crown, descending sides, and a wide flared lower rim. A short detached clapper mark sits directly beneath the centre of the straight bottom edge.

A long capsule-shaped input field contains two cross-shaped password characters followed by a low underscore. The characters run left to right, and the border has a slightly clipped lower-right corner.
Three hollow circular toe pads form an arch above a large triangular central pad. The upper toe sits highest, and the two side toes balance the open triangle beneath them.
A small standing figure with a round head and broad shoulders stands beside a tall ruler. Three short measurement ticks project inward from the ruler’s right edge toward the person.
A round head sits above a deeply curved chair seat and back. An angular body-and-leg stroke extends to the right, suggesting a seated person viewed from the side.
A circular head floats above a wide shoulder silhouette. The torso’s curved upper edge slopes gently into vertical sides and a flat base, forming a front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait.
A rounded pig’s face has two broad outward ears, small vertical eyes, and a large oval snout. The head is nearly symmetrical, with shallow dips where the ears meet its upper outline.
A horizontal capsule contains a check mark on the left and a cross on the right, separated by a diagonal divider. The opposing marks fill the two rounded halves of one compact privacy-choice symbol.
A small hollow circular head sits at the top of a long straight vertical shaft. The shaft descends from the circle’s lowest point, forming a balanced, upright pin silhouette.
An open circular arc curves beneath a straight upright stroke. The vertical stroke enters through the gap at the top and ends inside the circle, with both parts centred on one axis.
Three hollow teardrops form a triangular group, with one centred above two lower drops. Each drop has a pointed top and rounded base, and the lower pair spreads evenly to either side.
An upright sheet has rounded corners and a folded upper-right corner marked by a curved inner flap. Two horizontal text lines occupy the lower half, with the bottom line slightly longer.
A small upright phone overlaps the lower-left corner of a taller tablet. Both devices have rounded corners and short lower bezel dividers, with the larger outline interrupted behind the phone.
A broad bell has a smooth domed top, near-vertical upper sides, and a flared lower rim. A short horizontal clapper mark sits below the straight base, centred beneath the dome.
A large circular finger band supports a small angular gemstone at the top. The stone has a short flat top and sloping sides that narrow toward the attachment on the band.
The number 60 sits beside a broad curved arrow wrapping around its left side. The arrow rises from below the digits and turns across their top to a right-pointing head.
The number 75 sits beneath a broad curved arrow that wraps around its right side. The arrow curves upward from the lower right and ends in a left-pointing head above the digits.
A wide rounded rectangular panel contains two vertical slider tracks. A short horizontal control crosses low on the left track and high on the right, creating a balanced pair of adjustment controls.
A pointed shield has a raised central crest and curved sides tapering toward the bottom. A smaller matching shield contour follows inside it, creating a broad, symmetrical double border.
An angular lightning stroke stands between two groups of short falling precipitation marks. The small vertical dashes are staggered on either side, surrounding the bolt without a cloud outline.
An upright spoon with a broad oval bowl stands beside a knife with a curved triangular blade. Both handles descend vertically, and the knife blade projects to the right of its stem.
A wide rounded rectangular panel contains two horizontal slider tracks. A hollow circular knob sits left of centre on the upper track and right of centre on the lower track.
A round head with a horizontal cap line sits above curved shoulders. A wavy waterline runs beneath the torso, showing the front-facing swimmer rising from the surface of the water.
A broad tag angles down toward the right, with a short flat top and a clipped shoulder leading into its long sides. A small round attachment hole sits near the upper-left corner.
Three matching zigzag lightning strokes stand side by side in an evenly spaced row. Each leans to the right with a short horizontal middle segment joining its upper and lower diagonal arms.
A tapered waste bin has a wide horizontal rim and a domed lid rising above it. One vertical groove runs down the front of the body, which narrows to a rounded flat base.
A tall arched shackle rises from the right side of a rounded rectangular lock body and remains open on the left. A small upward-curving mark sits near the centre of the lock face.
A rectangular movie-camera body supports two round film reels, with the left reel larger than the right. A short tapered lens hood projects from the body’s right side.
A rounded rectangular wallet has a short fastening tab projecting from its right edge, marked by a small stud. A tilted card emerges from behind the upper edge of the wallet.
Two horizontal wind strokes extend from the left and curl back at their right ends. The upper stroke rises into a larger rounded loop, while the lower stroke curls downward into a smaller loop.
